KillCRAN

pracma

CRAN 2.4.6

All 454 exports and the datasets brown72 and titanium are checked against pracma 2.4.6. NumPy supplies arrays, the sample variance, and the FFT. quadprog, lsqlincon, and fmincon stop with R's message when the suggested packages are missing. There is no crate.
